Every entry is reviewed: false and source: draft until Dawa approves or replaces it; swapping his lines in is a change to this file only. tests/free-chart/signs.test.ts checks the shape and the copy rules.

entries.line: You come alive at the start of things. You would rather try and learn than wait and wonder.
Your feelings arrive fast and leave fast. You settle by doing something about them.
People meet your energy first. You come across as direct, quick, and ready to go.
You build slowly and you build to last. What you love, you keep.
You settle when things are steady and real. Comfort, for you, is something you can touch.
People meet your calm first. You come across as grounded, patient, and hard to rush.
You are made of questions. Two ideas at once feels like home to you.
You feel things by talking them through. A good conversation settles you more than silence does.
People meet your quick mind first. You come across as light, curious, and easy to talk to.
You care in practical ways. The people you keep close know exactly where they stand.
Your feelings run deep and remember everything. You settle among your own people, in your own place.
People meet your warmth first, and your caution. You take your time letting people in.
You warm a room by being fully in it. You do your best work where people can see it.
You need to feel seen, and you are generous when you are. Affection out loud settles you.
People meet your presence first. You come across as warm, bright, and a little theatrical.
You notice what others miss and you fix it quietly. Getting it right is its own reward.
You settle by putting things in order. A small useful task calms you more than a pep talk.
People meet your care for detail first. You come across as thoughtful, modest, and quietly capable.
You look for the balance in every room. Fairness and beauty matter to you in equal parts.
You feel best when things between people are right. A quarrel unsettles you until it is mended.
People meet your grace first. You come across as easy, fair, and good company.
You go all the way in or not at all. You would rather know the truth than feel comfortable.
Your feelings are private and strong. You trust slowly, and once you do, it is for good.
People meet your intensity first. You come across as focused, private, and hard to read.
You are always heading somewhere. A big question and an open road suit you.
You settle by moving. Room to roam, in body or in mind, keeps your spirits up.
People meet your optimism first. You come across as frank, friendly, and up for anything.
You play the long game. You climb steadily, and you keep your word.
You feel safest when you are useful and in charge of things. You carry a lot and say little about it.
People meet your composure first. You come across as capable, serious, and older than your years.
You see how things could be different. You are loyal to ideas, and to your friends.
You feel things from a little distance. Some space to think settles you.
People meet your originality first. You come across as friendly, independent, and a bit unusual.
You feel your way through the world. You pick up what others feel before they say it.
Your feelings are wide and tidal. Music, water, or quiet time alone settles you.
People meet your softness first. You come across as dreamy, kind, and easy to confide in.
